title: Planning asks an open choice a goal leaves for each file it names, not for one of a pair
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose goal names two or more ledgers or files that the same open choice applies to while a gate answers it for only one of them, so the choice for each is asked before the start (SP-7nv2ffr2: ST-l2p6dpkr had gate g1 for _fetch_state.csv columns and the worker stopped mid-work on the same choice for _anchors.csv) (SP-7nv2ffr2 close).

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, types, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
def put(it):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', it['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(it))
bad = [dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])]
def gate(q):
    opt = ['a new column at the end', 'a new column after the key']
    return [dict(id='g1', kind='blocking', question=q, options=opt, recommendation=opt[0], answer=opt[0], by='operator', do=dict(zip(opt, ['ST-bbbbbbbb', 'ST-bbbbbbbb'])))]
goal = 'The census adds a column to _fetch_state.csv and to _anchors.csv, where each placement is left open'
put(dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='planted sprint', status='planned', goal='planted'))
put(dict(id='ST-bbbbbbbb', kind='story', title='planted one-file gate', status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal=goal, checks=bad, gates=gate('Where does the new column go in _fetch_state.csv?')))
put(dict(id='ST-cccccccc', kind='story', title='planted both-file gate', status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal=goal, checks=bad, gates=gate('Where does the new column go in _fetch_state.csv and in _anchors.csv?')))
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl_base.Backlog(d), types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
out = buf.getvalue()
print(out)
warn = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
sys.exit(0 if any('ST-bbbbbbbb' in w for w in warn) and not any('ST-cccccccc' in w for w in warn) else 1)
